sneg55-agent-starter-adopt-project.description: Apply agent-starter patterns to an EXISTING project - audits the codebase, proposes components by invasiveness tier (hooks, skills, CLAUDE.md, lint configs, patterns), and applies only what the developer approves. Use when the user says adopt, retrofit, "apply agent-starter to this project", or wants starter patterns in an existing codebase.
sneg55-agent-starter-adopt-project.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

sneg55-agent-starter-commit.description: Create a single well-crafted git commit from current changes. Analyzes diff, follows repo's commit style, and writes a concise "why not what" message.
sneg55-agent-starter-commit.tools: Bash(git add:*), Bash(git status:*), Bash(git commit:*)

sneg55-agent-starter-commit-push-pr.description: Full git workflow - creates branch, commits, pushes, and creates or updates a PR with summary and test plan.
sneg55-agent-starter-commit-push-pr.tools: Bash(git checkout --branch:*), Bash(git checkout -b:*), Bash(git add:*), Bash(git status:*), Bash(git push:*), Bash(git commit:*), Bash(gh pr create:*), Bash(gh pr edit:*), Bash(gh pr view:*),…

sneg55-agent-starter-dep-vuln-update.description: Use when dependencies in a repo have known vulnerabilities and need updating, including when the dep-vuln hook reports advisories at commit or merge request time, when the user asks to fix vulns, patch CVEs or GHSAs, run an audit fix, or bump vulnerable packages. Covers scanning tracked lockfiles with osv-scanner, choosing the smallest version that clears each advisory, overrides for transitive deps, verifying with the repo's own tests, and committing per repo.

sneg55-agent-starter-dream.description: Memory consolidation - review, merge, prune, and index memory files. Run periodically to keep memories organized and up-to-date.
sneg55-agent-starter-dream.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

sneg55-agent-starter-new-project.description: Full project bootstrap - interviews the developer (name, description, stack, components), then scaffolds directory structure, CLAUDE.md, config files, hooks, skills, and first commit.

sneg55-agent-starter-reflect.description: Per-project self-improvement - reads the .harness ledger and feedback memories, then proposes gated rule/threshold/ADR changes so the project stops repeating mistakes. Run periodically.
sneg55-agent-starter-reflect.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

sneg55-agent-starter-remember.description: Review auto-memory entries and propose promotions to CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, or shared memory. Also detects outdated, conflicting, and duplicate entries across memory layers.
sneg55-agent-starter-remember.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash

sneg55-agent-starter-simplify.description: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
sneg55-agent-starter-simplify.tools: Agent, Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep

sneg55-agent-starter-test-audit.description: Use when auditing, pruning or sweeping a test suite, when deciding whether a new or changed test earns its place, when a test passes but would not catch the bug it is named for, or when production exports exist only so tests can reach them.
sneg55-agent-starter-test-audit.tools: Agent, Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep
